summary: TransAct Technologies filed an 8-K announcing the planned retirement of President and CFO Steven A. DeMartino effective June 30, 2026. He will receive a pro-rated 2026 bonus of $101,989.50, 18 months of COBRA, a $100,000 transition payment, and accelerated vesting of 41,747 PSUs. An advisory agreement from July to December 2026 provides a monthly retainer of $33,996.50 for financial consulting. This is a planned CFO transition with compensation terms disclosed. Watch for the appointment of a successor.
